title: Awesome Agent Memory
subtitle: Keep useful context between conversations.
description: Persistent memory, recall, knowledge graphs, and context tools for AI agents.
scope: Tools with an explicit agent-memory or persistent-context interface. General databases and document search engines are excluded unless the linked project supplies an agent-facing memory layer.
questions: What is stored: messages, extracted facts, files, events, or graph relationships?
Can users inspect, correct, export, and delete the stored information?
Where is data stored, and what model or database services are required?
